Evelyn Taocheng Wang

Evelyn Taocheng Wang

25 September–13 December 2026
Goldsmiths CCA presents 'Being Poetic Ruins Life', the first UK institutional exhibition by Netherlands-based artist, Evelyn Taocheng Wang (b. 1981, Chengdu, China).

Episode 16: Katie Shannon

Episode 16: Katie Shannon

06 November–12 December 2026
Katie Shannon (b. Glasgow) is the latest artist to participate in CCA’s ongoing commissioning series Episodes. Her exhibition 'BACK/PRUNE/VIRGIN/RUIN' will present work across visual art, performance, writing, and event making.
